name: audit_old_days
label_en: days since an ad first spent for it to count as old in the audit
label_zh: 广告首次花费距今多少天算旧广告
explain: the data starts where the pulls do, so the age is a lower bound
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: audit_old_share
label_en: the share of spend on old ads that is worth a finding
label_zh: 旧广告占花费多少比例才列为发现
explain: a fifth of the money on ads that old says new creatives are not taking spend
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: audit_waste_share
label_en: the share of spend on ads with no result that is worth a finding
label_zh: 没有结果的广告占花费多少比例才列为发现
explain: under it the waste is the cost of testing
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: concentration_alert_share
label_en: top ads' share of spend that raises an alert
label_zh: 触发提示的头部广告花费占比
explain: an alert when the top ads' share of spend reaches this
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: audit_budget_use_low
label_en: under this share of its daily budget the live campaigns are not spending it
label_zh: 活跃活动花掉每日预算的比例低于此值即列为发现
explain: a budget that is not spent is not the limit
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: audit_budget_use_high
label_en: over this share of its daily budget the live campaigns are spending past it
label_zh: 活跃活动花费超过每日预算此倍数即列为发现
explain: a platform may overspend a good day, not every day
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client
